description: This Java source file defines the class 'GlobalEventRegistry', which manages the registration and deserialization strategies for 'Event' objects within a system that handles JSON-based events. It includes singleton pattern implementation, customization of event parsing strategies, and factory for creating parsing strategies based on annotations.

classes.name: GlobalEventRegistry
classes.description: This class is a singleton registry that manages strategies for deserializing Event subclasses from JSON objects and headers, allowing customization and providing a central point for event parsing strategies.

classes.name: EventParsingStrategyFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates parsing strategies for Event objects based on annotation metadata, supporting both current and deprecated strategies.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of GlobalEventRegistry.

methods.name: customize
methods.description: Creates a new registry with customized parsing strategies, replacing existing ones with provided strategies.

methods.name: resolveType
methods.description: Resolves the 'type' attribute from the JSON object, with fallback to legacy extraction method and exception if not found.
